⚔️ Welcome to Build An Army!

Recruit soldiers, fight enemies, and march across endless battlefields! 🌍🪖

🛡️ Build your dream army using units from the barracks!
💥 Survive enemy ambushes and conquer new lands!
🚀 Fight, earn money, and upgrade your troops every battle!
⚡ Unlock rare and legendary units, each with unique abilities!

⏰ Your army never rests—it fights and earns rewards even offline! 🤑
